description: Scientific PDF with embedded images and a dense table should keep table structure and surrounding captions.
notes: Known issue (docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md): native mbtpdf extraction loses inter-word spacing on this producer ('broken_spacing' route flag) and the dense table is not recovered, so table_compare and text_order are unmeasurable today. Thresholds pin the current floor (anchors 0.5, markdown_similarity 0.146 observed); disabled checks re-enable when extraction improves.
